In the game, a white-clad female character moves through a green-tiled jungle area. The streamer's facial expressions shift from intense concentration to wide-eyed excitement, her mouth opening in a shout while her hands remain steady on her phone. Yellow and pink text overlays flash across the bottom third of the frame. (3) The game screen transitions to the enemy base area, showing the character 'Diaochan' performing rapid spinning movements. The streamer is now more relaxed, gesturing with her left hand while speaking, with a blurred game interface visible behind her.
